algorithm.Title: Toothache - Female (Child)
algorithm.ContentSet: IST Open-Source Guideline Content | Child | Female
Definition: Toothache assessment decomposed from NHS.UK's published toothache guidance.
FirstAid: Call Qatar 999 now for airway, swallowing, eye or neck swelling and do not allow self-driving. Sit upright if breathing is easier, give nothing by mouth if swallowing is unsafe, and do not squeeze or pierce swelling. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.

questions.Question: Are shallow sores or ulcers inside the mouth the main concern rather than pain arising from a tooth?
questions.Information: Mouth sores without a primary tooth problem belong in the Mouth Ulcers pathway.

questions.Question: Is the area around the eye or neck swollen, or is swelling in the mouth or neck making it difficult to breathe, swallow, or speak?
questions.Information: NHS.UK toothache guidance lists spreading facial/neck swelling with airway or swallowing difficulty as an immediate emergency (a dental abscess can spread rapidly). Do not drive yourself to the emergency department.

questions.Question: Has the pain lasted more than 2 days, does it not go away with painkillers, or is there fever, biting pain, red gums, a bad taste, or cheek/jaw swelling?
questions.Information: NHS.UK guidance recommends contacting a dentist for these persistent or infection-suggestive symptoms.

questions.Question: Is this mild, recent tooth pain with none of the features above?
questions.Information: NHS.UK guidance describes mild, recent toothache as manageable at home while awaiting a routine dental appointment.

advice.Title: Emergency dental-infection precautions
Content: Call Qatar 999 now for airway, swallowing, eye or neck swelling and do not allow self-driving. Sit upright if breathing is easier, give nothing by mouth if swallowing is unsafe, and do not squeeze or pierce swelling. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
Call Back If: worsening swelling, drooling, breathing difficulty, confusion, or collapse.

advice.Title: Prompt dental assessment
Content: Use the Qatar governance-approved emergency-dental pathway. Do not use leftover antibiotics or place aspirin or caustic products on the gum. Medication requires age, pregnancy, allergy, kidney/liver disease, anticoagulant, and dose checks.
Call Back If: swelling, fever, trismus, poor intake, or worsening pain.

advice.Title: Temporary low-risk toothache care
Content: Use soft foods, avoid temperature triggers, and rinse gently with warm salt water only if old enough to spit safely. Confirm all pain medicines and oral gels with a dentist or pharmacist; do not delay definitive dental care.
Call Back If: pain persists, fever, swelling, poor intake, swallowing or breathing difficulty.
